label: magic-literal-or-constant-name
name: Bare literal in production code needs a name, source or comment; a named constant must not become a literal; a constant's name or spelling must match its partner idiom
description: What breaks: an added production line (h/ or src/) uses a literal other than 0/1 in address, size, stride, loop-bound, capacity or threshold arithmetic (position / 4 2620219338 '(4, 8, 32, 128 etc)'; / 2048 * 32 2915246595 '2048 is a bit cryptic'; tok / 128 2948416014; reserve(64) 3120756577 'why 64?'; 1024 * 1024 2636393495; / 2 3454926024; k_tmp[4][8] 2897210663, 2897211589); a literal replaces a named constant that still exists (hwkv_max_layers -> 32 2915275194 'why replace ... with hard-coded 32?'; POS_DATA_SIZE -> sizeof(bf16) 2948209837; timeout_ns -> 1000 3307459854); a literal compares where the file already has a named macro for the role (layer == 0 next to LAYER_IDX_FOR_DEBUG 2737603648; pdc == 31 next to max_num_fetchers 2789750267); a count constant doubles as an error sentinel (NUM_CLASSES 3235796275); a message still prints the old value of a constant the PR changed (32 vs max_cmd_fifo_depth = 1024 3350031805); a constant silently fixes a model parameter (8192 page size assumes 8 KV heads 2947992404); a new sizing constant has no derivation and is baked into a class instead of a constructor argument so tests cannot reach wrap-around (inwork_ring_size = 2048 3350173837); a new constant spelling in shared code differs from its partner file's idiom (V_ODD_TOKEN_LANE_MASK_0XFFFF0000 vs hi_16_of_32 6021333114). Procedure: list literals in added production lines; for each search the file and its includes for a constant with the same value and meaning; for every removed named constant whose added twin is a literal ask why; for sizing calls ask what happens when runtime exceeds the value and whether a test can pick a smaller size; for every literal in a message compare with the constant it describes; for new constants in shared files compare the spelling with the idiom used around them. Ask form: 'why N?', 'what is this buying us?', 'we should use <constant> rather than the hard-coded 128', 'I really don't like all these magic numbers'.
disposition_reason: Check 13 fires only on value-suffixed constant families (2 rows in the corpus). The other 16 rows show the far more frequent trigger: any production literal without a role name, any constant-to-literal replacement, any literal duplicating a reachable constant, any undocumented sizing constant. The trigger must widen; the stem procedure stays.
agent_feasibility: yes for the literal scan, the removed-constant-to-literal diff and the existing-constant lookup; the model-shape assumption (2947992404) and hardware meanings need domain knowledge.
